answer_1.quote: Language modeling is the task of generating language from context. This is often framed as an autoregressive task, where a model predicts the conditional probability of the next word based on the sequence of previously observed or generated tokens.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on fine-tuning language models to generate text that matches the style and syntax of a target corpus by selectively training on informative examples.
